note: The five market scenarios published in the challenge README, transcribed to integer vUSD units per full vETH (200000 = 2000.00). The 'expected behaviour' column is the README's own wording, kept so a simulation can be read against what the organisers said they were testing rather than against what we assumed.

startingPosition.note: Per participant on join(). vETH units 100 = 1.00; vUSD units 100 = 1.00.

scenarios.name: gradual decline
scenarios.expected: Make a proportionate intervention before liquidation.

scenarios.name: sudden crash
scenarios.expected: React quickly at the first dangerous update.

scenarios.name: temporary wick
scenarios.expected: Hold or intervene minimally rather than closing unnecessarily.

scenarios.name: two-stage decline
scenarios.expected: Create sufficient protection or perform an efficient second intervention.
